summary.text: Karen Whitney is a Democrat running for Indiana House of Representatives District 28 in the November 3, 2026 general election against incumbent Republican Jeffrey Thompson.
A longtime higher education administrator and former university president and chancellor, she ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Karen Whitney was born in San Marcos, Texas, and graduated from Westbury High School.
She earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Houston in 1982, a graduate degree from the University of Houston in 1990, and a Ph.D. from the University of Texas at Austin in 2003.
Her career experience is in higher education administration.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a lifelong educator in public higher education and a former president and chancellor of universities who now advises and consults with university presidents and chancellors.
Whitney was the Democratic nominee for District 28 in 2024, when Thompson won with 71.8% of the vote to her 28.2%.
She advanced from the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary.
In the 2026 survey she called herself a "middle of the road Hoosier Democrat" and listed fighting corruption, funding schools and reforming taxes as her key messages.
